title: Available but Unclaimed: An Empirical Study of Human-AI Synergy
abstract: arXiv:2609.16793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People increasingly reason with large language models (LLMs), yet complementary capabilities do not guarantee outperforming both components. In a between-subjects study, participants (N=535) solved a 40-item battery of matrix reasoning, mental rotation, syllogisms, and letter-string analogies, unaided or with GPT-5.6-Luna, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.6 Flash, or Kimi K3. Each assisted trial required consultation with the model. Each model answered every item alone 100 times under matched elicitation. The assisted-unaided accuracy difference increased with item-level LLM competence. Deference varied across tasks and increased with competence within tasks. Post-advice confidence distinguished correct from incorrect answers less strongly than unaided confidence. In a reference comparison, about half the increase in LLM accuracy carried through to assisted accuracy. How much of that accuracy gain reached participants differed across the mode

translated_title: 可用却未被善用：人机协同的实证研究
translated_abstract: 人们越来越多地借助大语言模型（LLM）进行推理，然而能力互补并不保证协同表现优于双方各自单独的表现。在一项被试间研究中，535名参与者（N=535）完成了包含40道题目的测试组合，涵盖矩阵推理、心理旋转、三段论和字母串类比，条件为无辅助或借助GPT-5.6-Luna、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.6 Flash或Kimi K3。每次辅助试验都要求参与者咨询模型。在匹配的引导条件下，每个模型单独回答每道题目100次。结果显示，辅助与无辅助条件下准确率的差异随题目层面LLM能力而增加；顺从度在不同任务间存在差异，并在任务内随能力提高而增加；接受建议后的置信度区分正确与错误答案的能力弱于无辅助时的置信度。在参照比较中，LLM准确率的提升大约有一半传导到了辅助条件下的准确率，而这些准确率提升中有多少真正传递到了参与者身上，则因模式而异。
tldr: 该研究通过对535名参与者的对照实验发现，人机协同的收益取决于LLM在具体题目上的能力水平和人类对模型建议的顺从程度，且LLM准确率的提升仅有约一半实际转化为参与者的准确率提升。
en_tdlr: A between-subjects study with 535 participants reveals that human-AI synergy gains depend on item-level LLM competence and human deference, with only about half of the LLM accuracy improvements carrying through to assisted performance.
